title: Revamp table component UX: virtualized rows, column resizing, sorting & density modes
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Problem: The current table component struggles with large datasets (laggy scroll, layout shifts), lacks predictable column resizing behavior, and offers limited sorting/filtering affordances and density options. Goal: Ship a unified table spec and tokens that support virtualized rows, robust column resizing, multi-column sorting/filtering UX, and three density modes (comfortable / default / compact). This ticket covers design exploration, interaction specs, accessibility requirements, and handoff artifacts for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Designs for virtualized table prototype (row windowing) with sticky header and smooth scroll behavior provided
Column resizing interaction defined (mouse drag, double-click auto-size, keyboard resize) and documented with motion tolerances
Sorting & filtering patterns documented: single click sort, shift-click multi-column sort, persistent filter chips, and server/client sorting fallbacks
Density modes specified with token mappings for spacing, row height, typography scales, and icon sizes
Accessibility checklist completed (keyboard navigation, focus styles, ARIA roles/states, screen reader announcements for sort changes)
Handoff artifacts: Figma components, interaction prototype link, Confluence spec, and example storybook stories
engineering_notes: Recommend evaluating TanStack Virtual vs react-virtualized for row windowing; include estimates for SSR impact
Column measurement strategy: use ResizeObserver on header cells for auto-size; expose programmatic API for setColumnWidth
Server-side pagination/sorting contract: add optional sort[] query param for multi-column stable sort
Cache strategy: virtualized rendering means we must not rely on DOM for accurate width until column measured; provide initial estimated widths via tokens
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Thompson: Initial proposal posted. Goals and constraints added. Calling out accessibility and token mapping as first-class requirements.

2026-03-03 Design critique: PM requested clearer error states when client-side virtualization collides with server-side sorting (edge case: backend reorders while user has scrolled). Action: document server compatibility patterns and add UX for 'data changed' toast with option to refetch. Assigned to Ethan for mockups.

2026-03-05 Engineering sync (ENG-1892): Eng requested prototype with adjustable row buffer and measurable perf metrics. They prefer TanStack Virtual for better integration with our hooks-based table logic. Dependabot note: ensure no breaking license issues.

2026-03-06 Accessibility review: Keyboard resizing accepted with arrow-key + modifier semantics; added requirement for focus trap when editing column widths. Screen reader announcement phrasing suggested: 'Column <name> sorted ascending' and 'Column <name> size adjusted to <pixels>'.

2026-03-07 Usability test (5 participants): Findings - double-click to auto-size is discoverable but needs hover affordance on narrow headers; compact density improves scan time on large tables but increases visual noise for extended reading. Action: add subtle divider and increased emphasis in comfortable mode.

2026-03-09 Design handoff: Figma components and interaction prototype uploaded. Storybook examples created for: large dataset virtualized table, column-resize keyboard flows, multi-column sorting demo, and density mode toggles. Ready for engineering review.
2026-03-10 PM review: Approved to move to implementation pending minor copy changes on 'data changed' toast. Requested estimate for QA accessibility regression testing.
